# Section 010 Knowledge Check: Packaging Applications For GitOps

<!-- TODO(build): generated by /astrona-course-generate-assessment against the objectives below. Scenario questions, no recall trivia. -->

## Coverage

- Write a kustomization.yaml that sets a namespace, common labels and an image tag for a base
- Create staging and production overlays that patch the replica count and resources of one base
- Render an overlay with kubectl kustomize and compare it with the cluster using kubectl diff -k
- Generate a ConfigMap with configMapGenerator and explain why its name carries a hash suffix
- Diagnose a kustomize build error caused by a wrong resource path or a patch that matches no object
- Install a chart from an OCI registry with values from a values file and from --set
- Read the values and the rendered manifest of a release with helm get values and helm get manifest
- Upgrade a release, read helm history and roll back to an earlier revision
- Create a minimal chart whose templates read values and pass helm lint and helm template
- Choose between a Helm chart and a Kustomize overlay for a given delivery need
